title: Step Get 2
description: Wherever you Step you Get. Whatever you step on you Get. NOW IN V2.
body:
## Step Get
Whatever you Step on You Get.

> Operators Past Permission Level 3 Can Use ```/BanBlock```

Which Has 4 Parameters:
- Ban - Bans a Block (You Can't Get the Block After Stepping on It)
- UnBan - UnBans a Block (It has to be in the Ban List First)
- List - Lists the Banned Blocks
- Clear - Clears the Ban List

There are also Many Achivements in which There are Two Distinct Catagories:
- Total Blocks - Granted based on how many Total Blocks are Collected.
- Unique Blocks - Granted based on how many Unique Blocks are Collected
